Subject: Leadership briefing: team boundary adjustments & short-term succession plan

Team —

Putting this in your inbox ahead of Monday's QBR prep slot. Attached is a short briefing (leadership-brief-v1.docx) and an org-chart sketch (org-chart-proposal.pdf) that outline a small set of boundary adjustments we're proposing across Platform and Product Ops plus a temporary succession plan for two ICs moving into interim leads through Q4.

High-level asks:
- Please review the proposal and call out any places you think will materially shift roadmaps or SLAs.
- If you have language preferences for the announcement (tone: candid vs. coaching), add inline.
- Laura: can you sanity-check the build/ops impact (I noted potential 1–2 week reprioritizations).
- Vivek: want your read on escalation flows and whether we should stage the announcement regionally (EU first).

Timing: planning to run this as a short leadership readout on Wed 6/23 during the 10:00 slot; goal is to finalize wording by EOD Tuesday (6/22).

Notes in the doc: executive summary, rationale (reducing handoffs on inference infra), people transition plan, and rollback criteria. This is intentionally surgical — we're not doing a broad reorg, but tightening handoffs and creating two interim leads.
